title: Maha hill tragedy: New video shows mother kneeling before son, begging him to step back
content: A tragic scene unfolded at Khavdya Dongar when a teenager jumped to his death, despite his mother's heartfelt pleas, where she knelt in an attempt to save him. Villagers and police labored for over three hours to reach him, but as his father tried to pull him back, calamity struck, resulting in the loss of both parents during this devastating fall.

title: Torso in suitcase: Victim is Tamil woman, police hunt on for Odia couple

Special teams are currently tracking the suspects' mobile signals to apprehend them.

title: US FTA proposal: What are the '3 American demands' that became deal breaker for Canada
content: In a significant turn of events, Canada has halted trade negotiations with the United States due to unresolved disagreements. Three critical demands from the US regarding Canada's auto industry and trade agreements proved too contentious. Additionally, restrictions concerning language and culture were deemed unacceptable. As a result, both nations are now enacting retaliatory tariffs on each other's products.

title: Ugly scenes! Jaiswal, Fernando clash after heated send-off in Colombo - Watch

By the end of the morning session, India found themselves at 88/2 after winning the toss, maintaining a lead of 1-0 in the two-match Test series following their previous win.

title: 'I was fifteen and riveted': What Steve Jobs said that hooked a young Michael Dell
content: In his memoir Play Nice But Win, Michael Dell recalls meeting Steve Jobs in the spring of 1980 at a Houston computer user group, aged just fifteen. Jobs, then 25 and weeks from Apple's IPO, spoke about personal computers revolutionising the world. Dell writes he was riveted, and could not have imagined that in five years, Steve Jobs and he would be colleagues and friends, long before their famous Apple rivalry.

title: 'Awarapan 2' BO Day 10: Emraan Hashmi sequel targets Rs 130 crore India net
content: Awarapan 2 continues to hold strong as it heads into its second weekend, with the film showing renewed strength through its second week after settling into a steady weekday rhythm. Emraan Hashmi's sequel has comfortably outpaced its Independence Day rivals and shows no signs of slowing down meaningfully, adding healthy sums on both Day 8 and Day 9. title: Microsoft has a 6-word answer for students wondering if coding is still worth it
content: Microsoft Learn has told students on X that learning to code is worth it "now more than ever", even as AI writes a growing share of software. Satya Nadella says AI already produces up to 30% of Microsoft's code, while Google puts its figure at 75%. The skill has not died, it has shifted from writing syntax to reviewing, debugging and directing AI-generated code.

title: Medical debt relief model: MacKenzie Scott’s gifts erase $40 billion; $10 cancels $1,000
content: MacKenzie Scott pioneered large-scale medical debt relief through significant donations. Her gifts enabled the abolition of over forty billion dollars in medical debt. This initiative has provided relief to millions of families across all fifty states. Scott's model has also inspired other billionaires to contribute to debt eradication efforts. While philanthropic efforts offer immediate relief, systemic reforms are needed for lasting change.

title: Before AI, there was the Mechanical Turk: The chess machine that wasn’t
content: The Mechanical Turk first appeared in 1770 as a chess-playing machine that astonished audiences across Europe and the Americas. It played Benjamin Franklin and Napoleon Bonaparte, but the secret was a skilled chess player hidden inside its cabinet. Despite widespread suspicion, the illusion endured for decades. Its story offers a striking reminder that the impression of an autonomous mind can hide the reality behind it.

title: Delhi cops attacked with bricks, sticks, chilli powder during patrol; teen held

title: 'I fought cancer to see my son play for India': Saransh's long road to Test cricket

title: China residents found three king cobra nests, including one guarded over 72 eggs

One nest, situated close to Kunming, was remarkable for its clutch of seventy-two eggs, indicating possible group guarding and diverse nesting practices. These findings significantly enhance the geographical information surrounding king cobra nesting behaviors.

title: Michigan woman gives birth in Uber, driver returns as baby’s godmother
content: Ray, 25, unexpectedly welcomed her baby daughter Grace in the backseat of whatley's car . the experience bonded the pair so much that now, one year later, Whatley, 35, joined Ray’s family to celebrate Grace’s first birthday .

title: Toddler dies after 'severe beating'; 18-year old mother, boyfriend arrested in Georgia
content: police responded to a report of an unresponsive child at a residence on Cartersville Street on august 3 . the child was taken to local hospital, where he was later pronounced dead . celso Edison Vicente Y Vicente was responsible for caring for the toddler on the day of his death .

title: ‘Silent guardian’: Rahul cast as ‘real-life batman’ in posters outside Congress HQ
content: posters portraying Lok Sabha leader of Opposition and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi as the “real-life Batman” have been put up outside Congress HQ in Delhi . the posters feature the message, “the silent guardian, a watchful protector. LoP Rahul, the real life batman.”

title: Daughter of MLA Rohit Pawar's PA found dead in Maharashtra's Baramati; cops launch probe
content: the girl was found near her residence in the Sainagar area of Rui village in baramati tehsil . police have launched an investigation and are examining the circumstances surrounding her death from all angles . the deceased was the daughter of Pawar's personal assistant, police said .

title: 'Vanished from tracking system': How Panama-flagged cargo ship sank off Odisha coast
content: MV Ocean Winner was carrying an iron ore cargo and had departed from Paradip Port . it was reportedly headed for Singapore, with an estimated arrival date of august 27 . the 225-metre-long ship was last reported more than 200 nautical miles off the Odisha coast before communication with it was lost .

title: Swiss tourist gets 1-year jail in Bali for mocking Hindu festival
content: Luzian Andrin Zgraggen, 26, was found guilty of violating Indonesia's new criminal code . he filmed himself walking to a beach during the festival and described the tradition as "crazy" the posts were widely shared on social media, triggering outrage among balinese residents .
